metadata.units: CE/NLL in nats; accuracy as fraction

a1.label: A1
a1.active_parameter_scope: Audited two-of-four expert accounting, including vocabulary head; not FLOPs.

hysparse2.label: HySparse2
hysparse2.active_parameter_scope: Audited two-of-four expert accounting, including vocabulary head; not FLOPs.

training.sampling: Uniform selection by logged training-row index, preserving first and last; no averaging or smoothing. All validation rows retained.
training.scope: Training CE is the logged update minibatch; validation CE uses the fixed 262,144-target training-validation set.

quality4k.scope: One training seed per arm; descriptive results, no measured training-seed noise floor.

context4k.scope: Same final targets across prefixes within this cohort; 4K and 32K are different cohorts.

context32k.scope: Same final targets across prefixes within this cohort; 4K and 32K are different cohorts.

a1.scope: Diagnostic observations from numerically failed paths; not validated serving performance.

hysparse2.scope: Diagnostic observations from numerically failed paths; not validated serving performance.

cost.scope: Allocated GPU-hours for the two main training jobs and three final evaluation jobs only. Excludes tuning, earlier probes and failed/replaced setup; not total project cost or GPU utilization.
